references.observed: Project authors describe the asymmetric double-curvature 289 m arch with an 834 m crest, six surface gates, seven deep outlets, a plunge pool and auxiliary weir.
Owner gives the 709 m centerline arc length.
Oblique photograph shows narrow crest, red gantries, vertically finned intake block and shelves across the downstream arch face.
Completed downstream photograph shows six open crest-level gate slots and seven lower chutes under the long separation gallery.
The curved reservoir face, two water bodies and named tunnel system identify the Baihetan Dam arch.
Operator confirms the 825 m normal reservoir level.
